summary.headline: Dinner Omens and Dietary Rules
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging the success of an authority from malefactors, benefactors, triplicity lords, angles, stars, and the Moon, followed by omens for preparing dinner and dietary prohibitions based on planetary positions in Pisces, Libra, Gemini, Virgo, and Sagittarius.
